1. **Case Insensitivity**: The system will ignore the case of the input password, so "eclipse52", "ECLIPSE52", "Eclipse52", etc. will all be treated as valid.
2. **Trailing Whitespace**: The system will ignore any trailing whitespace characters (spaces, tabs, etc.) at the end of the input password.
3. **Leading Whitespace**: The system will also ignore any leading whitespace characters (spaces, tabs, etc.) at the beginning of the input password.
4. **Multiple Spaces**: The system will treat multiple spaces between characters as a single space, so "eclipse 52" will be treated the same as "eclipse52".
